training.precision: BF16 train with FP32 NLL; FP32 clean validation
training.augmentation: See implementation_assumptions.md; ESC50 pinned category split

comparison.unit: scene, with seeds averaged within scene
comparison.cohort: strict scene/query ID equality, all19 Val9965 queries

temperature_calibration.group: scene source-family prefix, stable hash ordering and round-robin assignment
temperature_calibration.selection: minimum equal-scene nearest-grid NLL on other development folds
temperature_calibration.evaluation: held-fold region mass/NLL, confidence ECE/Brier and normalized entropy
temperature_calibration.limitation: checkpoint selection uses all Val19; held-development calibration is not independent Test validation
temperature_calibration.boundary_optimum: flag explicitly; no silent range retuning

geometry_observability.scope: post-hoc GT-derived ideal ray profiles only, not model input or pose proposal
geometry_observability.margin: minimum incorrect-region profile MAE minus minimum joint-correct-region profile MAE
geometry_observability.near_alias_count: incorrect profiles within0.05m mean ray error of best correct profile
geometry_observability.limitation: equal-scale ideal-profile matching is not a mathematical upper bound for learned uncertainty

fusion_controls.independent_equal: paired-seed A0+A1 predictions, equal mixture within V FoV, A only outside; moment matched Laplace
fusion_controls.A3_uniform: same trained A3 V/A/AV predictions; equal expert weights insideFoV, equal A/AV outsideFoV; moment matched Laplace
fusion_controls.limitation: post-hoc weight intervention does not estimate effect of training from scratch with fixed router; independent experts and joint model have different compute/parameter use
